source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per turn, when a unit with this ability is picked to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), it can use this ability rather than make any ranged attacks.

If it does, you may add a new 1-model **MUCOLID SPORES** unit to your army and place it on the battlefield more than 8" horizontally from every enemy unit and wholly within 18" of the model using this ability.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
